title: Pinewatch Hunt
pitch: A quiet first-person bow hunt in a sunlit pine forest: follow hoofprints, approach one wary deer, draw and release, retrieve, and try again.

authorization.basis: User said to execute PROMPT.md in a separate worktree. That launch prompt delegates bounded design, implementation, installs, validation, checkpoint commits and independent critic/fix work; no push or publication.

mustHave: Owned registered forest fork and preserved provenance
Grounded collision-aware walking, quiet approach and visible tracks
One articulated deer with idle/walk/alert/flee and simple detection
Visible bow and draw/release, occlusion-aware hit/miss, retrieval
Start, pause/focus loss, success/failure and clean retry
Real-input success and failure, 1600x1000 Balanced measurement, independent art critique
outOfScope: Framework edits, other games, promotion, migration, push or publish
Economy, survival, multiplayer, multiple species, gore or huge maps

milestones.title: Owned foundation
deliverables: Relocated launch packet, plan and provenance
acceptance: CLI validation and dry run pass; committed starter fork used

milestones.title: Complete hunt
deliverables: Controller, rules, deer, bow, tracks and HUD
acceptance: Failure, pause, focus, collision and restart verified

milestones.title: Verified handoff
deliverables: Checks, committed checkpoints, separate art reviews and docs
acceptance: Art score 8/10 or four rounds honestly reported

lanes.role: Integration, controller, rules, presentation, tests and records
Read-only separate demanding art and correctness critic of committed captures

playthrough: Start from visible UI, follow tracks using real keyboard and mouse, draw and release a hit, walk to retrieve, result and restart
Miss, alert/flee and exhausted-arrow failure; recover by retry
Pause during draw and movement, pointer-lock exit/focus loss, collisions, fresh restart
Capture committed builds only; separate critic reviews up to four rounds

stopAfter: Complete playable user handoff after correctness and bounded art cycle. Stop at 8/10 or four rounds; report failed art gate at cap. No further depth before user playtesting.
